story: Nifty 50 opened at 25,839, a gap-down of 0.17% from the previous close of 25,884.
The index dipped to a low of 25,566 (-1.23%) around 3:10 PM and touched a high of 25,909 (+0.10%) around 9:15 AM.
It settled at 25,607 (-1.07%), near the bottom of the day's range, so sellers stayed in charge into the close.
9 of the 50 Nifty stocks advanced and 40 declined; Bank Nifty outperformed (-0.78%).
Latest institutional data (25 Nov): FII/FPI net +4479 Cr, DII net +4019 Cr.
risks: Markets stay shut until Monday (3 days): weekend news, geopolitics and any Wall Street or Asian moves will all be priced in at the open.
Wall Street trades through tonight (from about 7:00 PM IST); the S&P 500 last closed at 7,182.78 (-0.25%), so US data and Fed commentary can swing the opening.
Brent crude is at US$92.44 (-2.29%); a sharp fall would help oil marketers and the rupee.
Currency and yields to track: USD/INR 92.980 (+0.80%), US 10-year yield 4.85% (-1.14%). A firmer dollar or higher US yields usually weigh on foreign flows.
GIFT Nifty keeps trading into the late evening, now 25,665.5 (+0.23% vs Nifty's close): the best live read on the next opening.
